title: Ex-Nubank team raises $85m for Decade, an AI wealth adviser promising “a generation of millionaires”
excerpt: Two former Nubank leaders raised $85m, Latin America's largest seed round, for Decade, an AI wealth adviser promising "a new generation of millionaires."
content_html:
Two former Nubank executives have raised $85m to build an AI wealth adviser in Brazil. Their backers call it the largest seed round in Latin American history. The startup, Decade, came out of stealth on Tuesday with money from Greenoaks, Benchmark and Diffusion, and a striking promise: to create “a new generation of millionaires.”

The founders carry weight. Vitor Olivier was an early engineer at Nubank and rose to chief technology officer as it grew into the world’s largest digital bank, with more than 100 million customers. Felipe Meneses, the first Brazilian named a Thiel Fellow, founded the AI startup Hyperplane, which Nubank later bought. Bloomberg first reported the launch.

The round, worth about R$440m, is unusually large for a company still on a waitlist with nothing shipped. The investor list explains the nerve. Greenoaks has backed Stripe, Revolut and Anthropic. Benchmark seeded Uber and Snap. Diffusion was founded by Victor Lazarte, who built Wildlife Studios into Latin America’s largest gaming company.

The pitch, and the gap it names

Decade’s case starts with a real problem. Only about a third of Brazilians hold any investment, and just 7% can live off their savings in retirement. That is despite the country leading the world in payments. Pix, Brazil’s instant-payment system, handles close to 100 billion transactions a year.

The company frames money management as a “second job” most people do badly, steered by advisers whose pay depends on selling them products. “Financial services are complex by design and often monetised through asymmetry of information,” said Meneses. “AI collapses that asymmetry.”

So Decade pairs each client with a senior human adviser and a proprietary AI model that holds their full financial picture and remembers every conversation. The two watch spending and portfolios around the clock, the company says, pulled together through Open Finance. It is a bet that a human plus AI beats either on its own.

A very big claim

The ambition is deliberately grand. “That level of attention used to be reserved for the ultra-rich,” Meneses said. “Now we can create an entire generation of millionaires.” Neil Mehta of Greenoaks put it more plainly. Nubank cut banking fees for tens of millions, he said, and “investing never got its turn. Now it will.”

It is a lot to promise from a standing start. Decade has raised more than any Latin American seed before it, yet it has no launched product and no track record. Its human-plus-AI model also has to prove it beats a cheaper robo-adviser. AI wealth tools are multiplying fast, and “a generation of millionaires” is a marketing line, not a forecast.

The deal also fits a pattern. Greenoaks and Benchmark wrote a similar outsized cheque months ago for Pax, an AI public-safety startup, in another record Latin American seed. Big US funds are treating Brazil as fertile ground for AI companies with sweeping social pitches. Whether Decade can turn $85m and a manifesto into millions of richer Brazilians is the part that waits on a product.

content_html_zh:
两名前 Nubank 高管筹集了 8500 万美元，在巴西建立人工智能财富顾问。 他们的支持者称其为拉丁美洲历史上最大的种子轮融资。 周二，这家名为 Decade 的初创公司从 Greenoaks、Benchmark 和 Diffusion 那里获得了资金，并做出了一个引人注目的承诺：创造“新一代百万富翁”。

创始人很有分量。 Vitor Olivier 是 Nubank 的早期工程师，随着 Nubank 发展成为拥有超过 1 亿客户的全球最大数字银行，他晋升为首席技术官。 Felipe Meneses 是第一位被授予 Thiel Fellow 称号的巴西人，他创立了人工智能初创公司 Hyperplane，后来被 Nubank 收购。 彭博社首先报道了此次发射。

本轮融资金额约为 4.4 亿雷亚尔，对于一家仍在候补名单上且尚未发货的公司来说规模异常庞大。 投资者名单解释了这种神经。 Greenoaks 已支持 Stripe、Revolut 和 Anthropic。 Benchmark 种子轮是 Uber 和 Snap。 Diffusion 由 Victor Lazarte 创立，他将 Wildlife Studios 打造成拉丁美洲最大的游戏公司。

音高和它所命名的间隙

Decade的案例始于一个现实问题。 只有大约三分之一的巴西人持有任何投资，只有 7% 的人能够在退休后依靠储蓄生活。 尽管该国在支付方面处于世界领先地位。 巴西的即时支付系统 Pix 每年处理近 1000 亿笔交易。

该公司将资金管理视为大多数人做得不好的“第二工作”，由顾问指导，而顾问的薪酬取决于向他们销售产品。 梅内塞斯表示：“金融服务的设计很复杂，并且通常通过信息不对称来货币化。” “人工智能打破了这种不对称性。”

因此，Decade 为每位客户配备了一位高级人类顾问和一个专有的人工智能模型，该模型可以掌握他们的完整财务状况并记住每一次对话。 该公司表示，两家公司通过开放金融全天候监控支出和投资组合。 这是一个赌注，人类加人工智能可以单独击败其中任何一个。

一个非常大的索赔

野心是故意宏大的。 “这种程度的关注过去是为超级富豪保留的，”梅内塞斯说。 “现在我们可以创造整整一代的百万富翁。” Greenoaks 的 Neil Mehta 说得更直白。 他说，Nubank 削减了数千万美元的银行费用，但“投资却从未得到落实。 现在会了。”

从一开始就需要做出很多承诺。 Decade 筹集的资金比之前任何拉丁美洲种子都多，但它还没有推出产品，也没有任何跟踪记录。 它的人类加人工智能模型还必须证明它击败了更便宜的机器人顾问。 AI财富工具正在快速倍增，“一代百万富翁”只是一句营销话，而不是一个预测。

这笔交易也符合一种模式。 Greenoaks 和 Benchmark 几个月前为 AI 公共安全初创公司 Pax 开出了一张类似的巨额支票，这是另一笔创纪录的拉丁美洲种子资金。 美国大型基金将巴西视为人工智能公司的沃土，并进行了广泛的社会宣传。 Decade 能否将 8500 万美元和一份宣言转化为数百万更富有的巴西人，这是等待产品的部分。
